denoiser.description: Original forward results and corresponding parameters for plain/AdaLN, conditional/unconditional; 5 rows, 2 numeric coordinates, categorical widths 4 and 3. New module parameter names mapped before saving. Inputs, weights, and expected outputs are self-contained.

metrics.description: Original publication bootstrap: fit preprocessing on real training rows only; 10 rounds of independently initialized same-seed real/synthetic subsampling. CSV rows [0,120) real train, [120,180) test, [180,end) synthetic. Numerical x/y, categorical cat, regression target y. Seed 33; XGB 100 trees/depth10/lr0.1/seed42. DCR uses original privacy implementation on same tables.
